metadata.description: Open-source Claude skills from Webgrip, each shipped as its own plugin.

plugins.name: webgrip
plugins.description: The whole Webgrip skills estate as one namespaced plugin — every skill loads as webgrip:<skill>, so it can sit alongside another estate's same-named skills.

plugins.name: adr-writer
plugins.description: Write, amend, and supersede Architecture Decision Records in MADR 4.0.0 — locate or bootstrap an ADR directory with template and registry index in any repo, keep decision history append-only through ratifications, reverts, and supersessions, and enforce file-to-index consistency with a bundled CI-ready validator.

plugins.name: agent-instructions
plugins.description: Set up any repository for AI coding agents end to end and keep it right: one canonical AGENTS.md with CLAUDE.md importing it, knowledge in docs, one path-rule source generated for every tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity, Devin, Cline, Kiro, CodeRabbit), skills, MCP, cloud-agent and review-bot setup, and a CI check; plus auditing, slimming and probe-testing instruction files, and generator-safe layouts for Laravel Boost and friends.

plugins.name: blog-writer
plugins.description: Write, edit, and syndicate technical blog posts: evidence-first drafting, hook workshop, single-dimension edit sweeps with a de-AI-ify pass, fresh-reader testing, and per-platform adaptation for HN, LinkedIn, Substack, dev.to, Reddit, and Lobsters.

plugins.name: dependency-intake
plugins.description: Read the release notes of dependency updates against the repo's own source: what breaks, which workarounds retire, what to adopt, and which tickets follow.

plugins.name: devtool-social
plugins.description: Reach developers and technical buyers with social content for a founder-led developer tool: which platform does which job, Shorts cut from long audience videos, hooks, a launch order, claims that survive developer scepticism and metrics that mean something, each rule labelled by evidence.

plugins.name: domain-language
plugins.description: Define and maintain a project's ubiquitous language (terms, entities, rules, events) in docs/domain/model.yaml, and generate documentation, diagrams, Context Mapper exports, health scores, and feature specs from it.

plugins.name: edge-hosting
plugins.description: Ships static sites, Workers and private pages on Cloudflare's free edge tier with wrangler: Workers static assets over Pages, routes vs custom domains, www-to-apex redirects, DNS as code, Zero Trust Access gating with expiring per-recipient share links, previews and least-privilege CI tokens, a wrangler config linter and live-site prober, and when another host wins.

plugins.name: expressive-design
plugins.description: Designs and builds distinctive, memorable web pages from the subject's own evidence: a claim ledger, one thesis object carrying the identity, a still composition judged with motion off, parallel design directions, a motion contract per effect, a sourced Baseline and WCAG 2.2 floor, and a dependency-free source scanner for reduced-motion, zoom, focus, layout-shift, template-look and fake-proof failures.

plugins.name: guard-secrets
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that hard-blocks plaintext-secret leaks before an edit/write runs: no decrypted secret artifacts, SOPS files must stay ciphertext, and a best-effort gitleaks scan. The Claude Code twin of the estate's opencode guard-secrets plugin — same secrets floor, both tools.

plugins.name: harvest-knowledge
plugins.description: Mine durable, reusable knowledge out of Claude conversation threads with a three-phase workflow — distill each thread into a self-contained digest, consolidate many digests into one deduplicated truth-checked knowledge set, then synthesize repo docs, CLAUDE.md rules, new-skill candidates, and memory updates from it.

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: Detects and removes the tells of AI-generated writing in English and Dutch, or keeps them out while drafting: a consolidated catalog (negative parallelism, colon reveals, rule of three, em-dash density, hollow intensifiers, promotional and vague-attribution content, chatbot artifacts, and for Dutch the translationese layer of English-shaped Dutch), a register-aware procedure with fact and voice protection, and a dependency-free regex scanner for CI.

plugins.name: journey-distiller
plugins.description: Decides who a product is for and which user journeys it must support before screens are designed: a role cast from junior developer to buyer and client, owner decision rounds on an answer page that stores the answers, job stories and needs, the top journeys with actors, stages, permissions, audit events and success measures, and an enterprise round on organisation model, roles, SSO, review routing, policies and audit, landed as a concept doc, decision records and Definition-of-Ready tickets.

plugins.name: kpi-groomer
plugins.description: Define, groom and facilitate KPI sets for teams and organizations.

plugins.name: linkedin-post
plugins.description: Gets a LinkedIn post read: the 2026 ranking mechanics (the external-link penalty and the dead first-comment workaround, comments weighing 8 to 10 times a like, dwell time as the top signal, personal profiles out-reaching company pages 5 to 10 times), the plain-text formatting the editor will not destroy on paste, accessible emphasis instead of Unicode pseudo-bold, and the posting window.

plugins.name: mcp-server
plugins.description: Designs, builds, secures, deploys and evaluates MCP servers on the stateless 2026-07-28 spec with 2025-11-25 back-compat: agent stories, deployment choice, tool surface by size, descriptions, schemas, outputs, errors and annotations, lethal-trifecta threat model, OAuth resource-server auth with PRM, audience checks and pre-registered clients, client limits for Claude, VS Code and Cursor, Inspector, conformance, agent evals and a tools/list linter.

plugins.name: product-owner
plugins.description: Run any ticket board as product owner — Vikunja and ClickUp adapters, research-backed Definition of Ready, agent-ready gating for AI-executed work, a Definition of Mergeable for every PR, flow metrics, and evidence-based closing.

plugins.name: product-owner-contract
plugins.description: Webgrip's board contract for the product-owner skill: the default team's Vikunja stage ladder and pull criteria, label dimensions, ratified Definition of Ready, ticket template, golden tickets and Definition of Done, plus a per-repo overlay hook.

plugins.name: product-ux
plugins.description: Designs, critiques and builds product interfaces people use repeatedly: an evidence ledger instead of invented personas, job stories and top tasks, flows before screens, a state inventory for every view, sourced pattern rules for forms, navigation, feedback, tables, search, onboarding and AI features, a token-based visual system, a WCAG 2.2 and EAA floor, heuristic evaluation with severities and KLM estimates, and a dependency-free source scanner for unlabelled fields, fake buttons, blocked paste, deceptive consent, vague errors and other UI failures.

plugins.name: protocol-fit-research
plugins.description: Evaluate an external protocol or standard against a project's architecture seams via parallel research fan-out.

plugins.name: refactoring-economics
plugins.description: Refactor agent-maintained code where it measurably lowers what coding agents spend on future changes: git-hotspot targeting with agent share, a repeated-run token measurement harness over the agent's own usage stream, Fowler-catalog refactorings ordered by what shrinks the read set, tool-driven execution with a per-step gate, and a break-even model priced per token class with a safety factor.

plugins.name: search-visibility
plugins.description: Gets static sites on Cloudflare's edge found in Google and Bing and cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and AI Overviews: crawler access and Cloudflare AI bot settings, one canonical URL per page, page signals, answer-first content, an evidence-graded verdict on GEO and llms.txt, and a build plus live-site scanner.

plugins.name: secrets-levels
plugins.description: Places a secret at the right level of the Webgrip estate and names the manifest that puts it there: floor (SOPS), vault (OpenBao), cluster (External Secrets), bridge (Forgejo Actions and Cloudflare Worker secrets), short-lived (OIDC, dynamic credentials, per-run tokens), person (a laptop). The placement half of the secrets model; guard-secrets is the enforcement half.

plugins.name: security-review-triage
plugins.description: Defensive security review and triage: decide whether a finding or CVE is real and affects you, size its blast radius, map it to advisories, disclose privately, and prove a fix works both ways.

plugins.name: seekframe
plugins.description: Make motion-graphics explainer videos from code with the seekframe app: a TOML project of shared claims, hooks and closes composed into one cut per audience, a deterministic seek(t) scene page rendered in headless Chromium with motion blur, a synthesized score, careful per-line ElevenLabs voice-over that re-times the scenes, subtitles, 16:9 and 9:16 Shorts, and a YouTube upload sheet; plus import of old videos.mjs projects.

plugins.name: session-tldr
plugins.description: A TL;DR of the current agent session that the person can act on in one reply: what is done and how it was verified, what is left, what they need to know, and numbered decisions with a recommendation, with every PR, commit, ticket, file and CI run linked and checked against the live repository.

plugins.name: site-performance
plugins.description: Makes static sites on Cloudflare's edge fast for real users and proves it with field data: Core Web Vitals diagnosed by subpart and phase, ranked fixes, edge delivery, RUM and APM choices with EU privacy, a DIY web-vitals beacon into Workers Analytics Engine, Lighthouse CI budgets, and a build plus live scanner.

plugins.name: skill-usage
plugins.description: Local skill-usage telemetry: a PostToolUse hook logs every Skill invocation to ~/.claude/skill-usage.jsonl (no network), and the bundled skill reports which skills are used, dead, or undertriggering.

plugins.name: skillsmith
plugins.description: Author, edit, and audit Claude Code skills for token-efficient, high-trigger-accuracy LLM ingestion: a verified token cost model, description-as-router rules, progressive disclosure into reference files, and skill eval methodology.

plugins.name: youtube-upload-kit
plugins.description: Package a video for YouTube and Shorts: thumbnails rendered from the video's own frames in brand fonts and colours, Test & Compare variants, titles, descriptions, chapters, end screens, captions, synthetic-content disclosure, unlisted feedback drafts and the Studio numbers to read, each rule labelled by evidence.
